name: o90314

schema.title: StyleSymbolReference
schema.description: The StyleSymbolReference is used to reference a symbol from a portal styleItem

name.description: Identifies a symbol in the style by name.

styleName.description: A registered web style name, such as `EsriThematicTreesStyle`

description: The symbol definition should be recorded as a **styleSymbolReference**. Its identifier within the style is **Frangula**, and it draws its visual definition from the registered web style named **EsriThematicTreesStyle**. This reference ensures that the Frangula tree symbol will render consistently using the Esri thematic tree styling conventions.
